# 💳 Firecrawl Website Design Clone

💳 Requires a Firecrawl API key — the hosted service is paid (usage-based credits). Curated by Skill Harbor — a design-extraction workflow that turns any website into a designer handoff: it pulls brand identity, colors, fonts, layout, images and a full-page screenshot via the Firecrawl MCP extract tools, then produces a DESIGN.md handoff document and renders a pixel-style HTML/CSS replica of the reference site, explicitly distinguishing observed design tokens from inferred guesses and iterating the layout in the browser until it matches. By @firecrawl, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: it reproduces an existing site's look — use it on sites you have rights to or for internal design research, not to ship someone else's design verbatim; it is Firecrawl MCP-centric and does nothing without the API key.
